annotations.title: Review checklist for agent UI screens

description: The checklist to run after each screen where an AI agent acts, before moving on: one line per check, each tied to a rule (model output is text, unknown stays unknown, a locked control says why, nothing pre-selected, approve the exact change, reasoning is believed, the app names the agent, say what can be undone, plus status, progress and accessibility). From the candor-agent-ui skill; works with or without Candor.
name: get_review_checklist
